diagnosis: The endpoint pauses an active APScheduler background job identified by job_id without checking whether the calling user is the tenant compliance admin managing that retention policy. Any logged-in user can pause data destruction and retention jobs of other tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/retention-jobs/purge_logs_tenant_beta_991/pause HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_jwt>
